notes.title: Graphic Options Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Thanks to your valuable feedback, I've rolled out some new features and improvements to the Graphic options:[/p][p][b]- Directional Display Option:[/b] You can now see all possible directions for a few seconds each time you enter a scene. ([i]This feature is disabled by default[/i] — enable it in the graphics panel if you want.)[/p][p][b]- Window Mode Switch:[/b] A new toggle button has been added to switch from Fullscreen mode to Windowed mode.[/p][p][b]- Tutorial Access:[/b] The tutorial button is now more visible and conveniently located in the main menu.[/p][p][b]- Camera Smoothing:[/b] I've smoothed out some camera rotations that were previously too fast for a better experience.

All these improvements can be tested in the demo.[/p][p]I appreciate your ongoing support and look forward to your feedback![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439988/a475c928da5ef03aabf79eb61d3c3a617ceb3613.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Note: Drawings replace texts in-game
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! The in-game text (which previously appeared when clicking on an item in the top black bar) has been completely replaced with drawings (except in the settings interface ofc).

Recent playtests has shown that this significantly improves the gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439988/7996f42a3f2de5bf542ea8d38a7475937a290a69.jpg[/img]

See you in the swamp! 🐸
